what it does: Every matching intent label, from a rules tab (whole column, BYROW + LAMBDA)
input cells: C2:C = keywords; Rules!A2:A = label, Rules!B2:B = pipe-separated words
formula:
=BYROW(C2:C, LAMBDA(kw, IF(kw="", ,
  IFERROR(TEXTJOIN(", ", TRUE,
    FILTER(Rules!A2:A, Rules!B2:B<>"", REGEXMATCH(kw, "(?i)\b(" & Rules!B2:B & ")\b"))),
  "Unclassified"))))

what it does: SERP features as search intent signals (all matching labels)
formula:
=LET(labels, TEXTJOIN(", ", TRUE,
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)Featured snippet|People also ask|Instant answer|Knowledge panel|Carousel|Thumbnail|Video preview|AI overview"), "Informational Intent", ),
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)Site ?links|Knowledge Graph"), "Navigational Intent", ),
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)Local pack|Shopping ads|Local teaser pack|Shopping results|Popular products"), "Transactional Intent", ),
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)Top ads|Bottom ads|AdWords top|AdWords bottom"), "Commercial Intent", ),
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)Reviews|Video|Top stories|Images|Twitter|Featured video|Image pack|Discussions and forums"), "Engagement/Entertainment Intent", )),
  IF(labels="", "No SERP feature signal", labels))

what it does: Split keywords into own brand, competitor brand and non-branded
formula:
=IFS(
  REGEXMATCH(C2, "(?i){brand name}|{brand variations and misspellings}"), "Branded - own",
  REGEXMATCH(C2, "(?i){competitor brand names and variations}"), "Branded - competitor",
  TRUE, "Non-branded")

what it does: Content types Google is featuring, from SERP features
formula:
=LET(labels, TEXTJOIN(", ", TRUE,
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)Video|Featured video"), "Videos", ),
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)Images|Image pack|Thumbnail"), "Images", ),
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)Top ads|Bottom ads|AdWords top|AdWords bottom|Shopping ads"), "Ads", ),
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)AI overview|AI Mode|AI summary"), "AI features", ),
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)Featured snippet|People also ask|Instant answer|Knowledge panel|Carousel|Video preview"), "Informational Features", ),
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)Site ?links|Knowledge Graph"), "Navigational Features", ),
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)Local pack|Local teaser pack|Shopping results"), "Local Features", ),
  IF(REGEXMATCH(J2, "(?i)Reviews|Top stories|Twitter|Discussions and forums"), "Social/News Features", )),
  IF(labels="", "No features", labels))

what it does: Classify pages per site section from the URL
formula:
=IFS(
  REGEXMATCH(A2, "/blog/"), "Blog Posts",
  REGEXMATCH(A2, "/white-papers/"), "White papers",
  REGEXMATCH(A2, "/news/"), "News",
  REGEXMATCH(A2, "/case-studies/"), "Case studies",
  REGEXMATCH(A2, "/insights/"), "Insights",
  REGEXMATCH(A2, "/(careers|about-us|contact|job-opportunities|clients|reviews|our-work|our-team|join-team)(/|$)"), "Branded Pages",
  REGEXMATCH(A2, "/(services?|expertise|hospitality-travel-tourism|economic-development|energy|higher-education|technology|financial-services)(/|$)"), "Services Pages",
  REGEXMATCH(A2, "/tag/"), "Tag Pages",
  REGEXMATCH(A2, "/page/[0-9]+"), "Paginated",
  TRUE, "Unclassified")

what it does: Classify rankings into opportunity buckets (handles decimal positions)
input cells: A2 = position (rank tracker or Search Console average position)
formula:
=IFS(
  NOT(ISNUMBER(A2)), "Not ranked",
  A2 < 1, "Not ranked",
  A2 <= 3, "Money Keywords - Protect (1-3)",
  A2 <= 10, "High-Potential Keywords - Move to top (4-10)",
  A2 <= 20, "Striking Distance Keywords - Prioritise improvements (11-20)",
  A2 <= 50, "Need Improvements (21-50)",
  A2 <= 100, "Low Ranked - Heavy content edits needed (51-100)",
  TRUE, "Not ranked")
